description: A four-bit binary adder: it adds the A number to the B number, takes in a carry from a lower stage and puts out the sum with a carry for the next.

inputs.text: One bit of the first number: A1 is worth one, A2 two, A3 four and A4 eight.
One bit of the second number: B1 is worth one, B2 two, B3 four and B4 eight.
A carry coming in from a lower four bits; a high here adds one to the sum. Unpatched it counts as low.

outputs.text: The least significant bit of the sum.
The second bit of the sum, worth two.
The third bit of the sum, worth four.
The most significant bit of the sum, worth eight.
10V when the sum comes to more than fifteen, carrying the ninth into the next four bits.

notes: A logic input counts as high once it rises above 2V and does not count as low again until it falls below 0.1V; a logic output is 10V for high and 0V for low.
To add more than four bits, patch the carry output of the module holding the lower bits into the carry input of the module holding the higher bits.
